annotations.title: Risk board of every USD stablecoin

description: Before parking funds in a stablecoin or as a daily depeg / bank-run monitor: every USD stablecoin above $10M with price, peg deviation (bp), 1d/7d/30d supply change and net flows, mechanism, chains, 0-100 risk score, tier, flags and market-wide alerts. PAID: $0.01 per call, no account. Pay with x402 over MCP (USDC on Base), or with a Research Pass (header Authorization: Bearer lp1...). An unpaid call returns the payment terms and charges nothing; bad input is rejected before any payment; failed work is never charged. Same data as GET /v1/stablecoins/board.

sort.description: supply (default) | risk | deviation | outflow (largest 7-day redemptions first)

symbols.description: Optional comma-separated tickers to restrict to, e.g. USDT,USDC,USDe (ignores min_supply_usd)
